_note: Playoff series model and Cup simulation. Fitted on 165 playoff series 2013-14..2024-25 (excl. 2019-20 bubble): P(team A wins series) = logistic(alpha * (b_power * power-rating difference + b_elite * elite-skater difference)). Power rating = end-of-season power formula (goals/game); elite = top-12 F and top-6 D by ice time with talent >= 90th percentile at the position. alpha = share of the fitted edge kept, chosen by backtesting the full simulation from early-season checkpoints in 8 seasons (calibration/experiments/cup_odds_backtest_*).

series_backtest.note: Share of 165 series won by the favorite by each measure, each season scored with weights fitted on the others.

stage_skill.note: Backtest of the full simulation from about 4 and 14 games played, 8 seasons: improvement in log-loss over giving every team equal odds (alpha 0.7).

cup_winners.note: Every Cup winner 2013-14..2024-25 (excl. 2019-20) had at least 2 elite (top-10%) skaters; 7 of 11 had 0 or 1 superstar (top 2%).

favorites: Each season's model favorite (avg ~13% Cup at alpha 0.7) won 1 of 8 Cups from the October checkpoint, 0 of 8 from November.
